tools.name: ship_order_to_fulfillment_partner
tools.description: Sends an order's packing details to the fulfillment partner's API and moves the order record from the pending orders table to the shipped orders table.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to hand off

params.name: warehouse_code
params.description: Code of the warehouse that will pack the order

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests

DATABASE_PATH = "store.db"
FULFILLMENT_API_URL = "https://api.fulfillment-partner.example.com/v1/shipments"


def ship_order_to_fulfillment_partner(order_id, warehouse_code):
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        pending_order_row = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM pending_orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if pending_order_row is None:
            return {"success": False, "error": "Order not found in pending orders"}

        shipment_payload_dictionary = {
            "order_id": pending_order_row["id"],
            "customer_name": pending_order_row["customer_name"],
            "shipping_address": pending_order_row["shipping_address"],
            "warehouse_code": warehouse_code,
        }
        fulfillment_response_object = requests.post(
            FULFILLMENT_API_URL, json=shipment_payload_dictionary, timeout=20
        )
        fulfillment_response_object.raise_for_status()
        tracking_number_value = fulfillment_response_object.json().get("tracking_number")

        database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO shipped_orders (id, customer_name, shipping_address, warehouse_code, tracking_number) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (
                pending_order_row["id"],
                pending_order_row["customer_name"],
                pending_order_row["shipping_address"],
                warehouse_code,
                tracking_number_value,
            ),
        )
        database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM pending_orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
        return {"success": True, "tracking_number": tracking_number_value}
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: grant_order_tracking_access
tools.description: Gives a person access to view an order's tracking page by creating a share token with a chosen permission level, and emails them the tracking link.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to share

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Email address of the person receiving access

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool

DB = "store.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.store.example.com"


@function_tool
def grant_order_tracking_access(order_id: int, recipient_email: str, access_level: str = "view") -> dict:
    if access_level not in ("view", "manage"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "access_level must be view or manage"}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return {"ok": False, "error": "Order not found"}

        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        exp = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(days=14)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO order_access_tokens (order_id, email, token, level, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (order_id, recipient_email, token, access_level, exp.isoformat()),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    link = f"https://shop.example.com/track/{order_id}?token={token}"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "orders@store.example.com"
    msg["To"] = recipient_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Tracking access for order #{order_id}"
    msg.set_content(
        f"You have been given {access_level} access to order #{order_id}.\n"
        f"Open this link: {link}\nThe link expires on {exp.date()}."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return {"ok": True, "expires_at": exp.isoformat(), "level": access_level}
